question: Is the temperature/object readout a different command or format on fw-147?
word_meaning: aptina/cmos(0), chip(4), object(8) - matches TemperatureResponseCommandHandler (object = u32(8)/100)
note: Command 0x04 and the 12-byte 3xu32 format are identical to fw-138 and to the decompiled app handler across versions. fw-147 sends the object word as literal 0x00000000, including immediately after a SAMPLE_SPECTRUM (LED fired). So obj_t being 0 on fw-147 is firmware not populating the word, not a different command, longer response, or parsing difference. Read-only: commands 0x04 and 0x02 only; no writes.
